The current codebook excludes employer associations and political staff. Older supplement sector labels were recoded accordingly. Board/advisory posts are retained but not treated as full-time employment.

2026-10-01 follow-up: supplied finer hospital/Lifeline chronology, added four previously missing government advisory appointments, corroborated basketball chair appointment and2025 Fujitsu departure, and recovered first-speech source after member webpage became a placeholder. Newly retrieved profile organisation dates remain self-reported; no claim of original screenshot reinspection or full-time work.

Avenues: indexed public profile (direct999), Gippsland Water2022 primary submission, basketball institution announcement, Hansard reproduction, Bass Coast Post interview, FCA/Fujitsu appointment coverage, hospital/charity annual-report and early energy regulatory searches. No new hours, farm remuneration or historical energy-control proof. Retain January versus February2023 Fujitsu start conflict and newly identified2021 versus2022 ViPlus end discrepancy. Profile additionally lists Hawthorn young executive committee from2015, chair2015–17, with ongoing marker that needs historical cessation confirmation; future follow-up lead. Seek primary hospital/charity board appointments, Woorayl tenure, energy employer contracts/control and leave.

Second follow-up2October2026: recovered omitted Russell Broadbent electorate-officer role from2018 career interview; identified family farm as equestrian business and July2016 Harvard study as possible leave/overlap requiring investigation. Corrected Woorayl employer spelling. Canadian Ontario Energy Board counsel and US Aldred-Crouch are namesakes;2023 mid-1990s Broadbent staff quote belongs John Pesutto, not Aldred. Source2018 relative departure statement/equivalent FCA name conflicts with established appointment notices; no dates overwritten. Original Australian Carbon Innovation PDF now404. Early regulatory and hospital searches yielded no new full-time/payroll evidence. Next pursue original Broadbent staff chronology, farm remuneration/dates, Simply Energy/Green Made Easy contracts/control and Fujitsu January/February2023 discrepancy. No totals or full-time assumptions added.

Third follow-up3October2026: the full text of Aldred's public Fujitsu departure post is now accessible and supplies role-scope detail across cybersecurity, AI, defence and national security. Fujitsu regional CEO Graeme Beardsell's public reply independently corroborates her strategic engagement across academia, government and industry peak bodies. The page still renders only a relative age, so the existing January2025 end remains based on the separate April interview; it does not resolve January-versus-February2023 commencement or hours. Searches for early energy, ministerial and Broadbent records otherwise produced no reliable new boundary; the apparent mid-1990s Broadbent quote again belongs John Pesutto and was rejected.

Fourth follow-up 4 October 2026: FCA succession reporting says Aldred exited in February 2023 and an acting CEO then served, conflicting with the inherited public-profile December 2022 endpoint while aligning with Fujitsu's separately reported February commencement. The later report is not an exact-day cessation instrument, so the existing structured date was not silently overwritten. Targeted early energy, Broadbent, farm and Fujitsu searches otherwise repeated existing material or unrelated namesakes; hours, leave, farm pay and the 2022–23 transition remain unresolved.

Follow-up2026-10-04: Added six omitted study entries and three federal advisory appointments from employer/speaker biographies and her own 2 September 2025 parliamentary speech. Bruce Billson’s employer statement resolves identity of the ministerial office without inventing exact dates. Woorayl service is expressly former by September 2025; actual cessation unknown. AICD direct maintenance redirect recorded; public index used. Early energy and historical Woorayl searches yielded no contracts or new hours. Study and advisory service remain excluded; Harvard July 2016 overlap requires leave evidence. Existing Fujitsu and FCA date conflicts preserved. Corrected one inherited source enum to news and elected-office day precision without changing facts.

Follow-up 2026-10-05: original VAGO2016–17 financial audit establishes state control of Latrobe Regional Hospital in that report year; public institution category refined while earlier whole-spell control remains unknown. Governance remains excluded. Local investment-plan reproduction independently corroborates federal committee appointment, without turning committee meeting dates into personal attendance or tenure. Fujitsu and Woorayl searches otherwise returned existing reported roles and conflicting January/February2023 transition evidence. No new personal hours, farm remuneration or leave record; preserve all conflicting dates and distinguish contemporaneous control from mere government funding. Seek hospital appointment/earlier control records and actual early energy/Fujitsu employment terms.
